Synthetic actual metric updates, not a query/write workload. All user memtables remain empty and uninitialized.
Shallow array bytes are not a complete retained-size or dominator result. Bounded ownership claims can overlap; do not sum them.
Class histograms and live heaps are separate instants. Layout defaults match recorded compressed-pointer and alignment options.
Single fixed-order sample per case. Whole-JVM heap varies with background state; no stable effect-size or throughput claim.
Six live heaps and six histograms were captured per case; created, scraped and rescraped were analyzed. The baseline and one/eight-worker intermediate heaps remain available.
